items.q: What does he say he experienced?
items.a: The **most fear of his life**, a body doing what he says a body should not. He has had **several exorcisms**. He has read maybe **half the Bible** and wants a series on every book.

items.q: Why might America stop being the superpower, on his account?
items.a: **China is going nuclear** while the US debates nuclear power and the grid. He cites the **petrodollar** and Professor Chung. Keystone: Biden said no, Canada dealt with China, tariffs he recalls from about **25% to 50% to 100%**.

items.q: Where does he stand on the parties?
items.a: He **wanted Trump to win** and says that was not a formal endorsement. He is unhappy now. He treats the parties as **converged** and will likely sit out unless a **third party** appears.

A guest is placed so **one sentence** travels, then a text says he called it. **Blair Skoro** is the example. He declines **White House photo invites**. The show does **150–200 million views a month** and is not on the popular-podcasts shelf.
